subject.title: feat(android): add Listen action speaking assistant messages via gateway TTS

question: Should the Android Listen feature land as part of the mobile transcript TTS direction tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/100708 once the gateway base PR, lifecycle blocker, and device proof are resolved?
rationale: The feature crosses Android UX, gateway TTS semantics, provider fallback behavior, and a protected maintainer-labeled product issue, so implementation correctness alone does not settle acceptance.

options.title: Proceed after blockers
options.body: Keep this PR open as the Android implementation candidate, but require the gateway base, lifecycle fix, and device proof before merge.

options.title: Pause Android UI
options.body: Hold this Android PR until the gateway method and mobile Listen product direction are accepted.

options.title: Defer transcript Listen
options.body: Close or pause the stacked mobile PRs if maintainers decide transcript playback should stay in Talk mode or a later voice roadmap.

recommendation.title: Proceed after blockers
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open as the Android implementation candidate, but require the gateway base, lifecycle fix, and device proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the current stacked direction in the canonical issue and has recent current-main history in the affected Android chat/session path.
